tasks.title: Fix dark mode white background areas
tasks.description: Update src/App.css to apply dark background to html and body elements. Currently the .app class has the correct background (var(--app-bg)), but the html/body elements showing on the sides are still white. Add 'background-color: var(--app-bg);' and 'transition: background-color 0.3s ease;' to the 'html, body' CSS rule (lines 23-29) so the entire page background matches the theme in both light and dark modes.
acceptance_criteria: No white areas visible on page sides in dark mode
Body and html elements use var(--app-bg) for background color
Background color transitions smoothly between light and dark themes
